name: @swf2es/codegen
description: ABC and AVM1 bytecode to ES module compiler (AssemblyScript → wasm); identical output in JIT and AOT modes

scripts.build:wasm: asc --config asconfig.json --target release && node stamp.ts dist/codegen.wasm && asc --config asconfig.testing.json --target release
scripts.build:wasm:debug: asc --config asconfig.json --target debug && node stamp.ts dist/codegen.wasm && asc --config asconfig.testing.json --target debug
